artifactType: independent bounded peer review of DMG 175 structured-controls R7 test-source proposal
decision: The proposed three-file test-source repair is internally consistent with the pinned historical and current S1 evidence. It preserves the historical all-pending assertion, verifies only the 13 independently accepted current row locations, retains the other control guarantees, and leaves all source-value/context/default/mechanics grades unassessed.

failure.observedFailure: working controls do not promote target/value/context review

replacementTest.review: The three legacy coverage cases remain: 82 legacy controls, the V2 82-to-0 regression, the V3 87-row/33-bullet coverage result, and no fabricated Mistletoe control. The former current all-pending assertion is moved to the pinned pre-location fixture. The current-input case requires the root location summary and bounds reviewed status to the exact 13 expected identities.

historicalStatusFixture.originCheck: PASS: fixture records exactly project the selected historical bindings' identity and status fields; the source blob SHA and byte size match the Git object at the pinned commit.
historicalStatusFixture.statusCheck: PASS: all records are field-target-pending, targetReview null, sourceValueStatus not-assessed-by-field-target-review, and contextStatus context-not-assessed.

multiplicity.reason: The 11 repeats are source-region alternatives for three bullet target keys: two appendix-c-character-subtable records, two appendix-c-character-levels records, and ten encounter-types records. The fixture preserves this historical multiset; they are not extra reviewed row targets.

rootAcceptanceSummary.derivationCheck: PASS: the raw receipt SHA matches the root manifest entry; the summary's manifest/receipt pins, superseded V2 receipt, source epoch, pixel-check summary, grade boundary, and all 13 target summaries agree with the raw root evidence.
rootAcceptanceSummary.scope: Clears only the root visual recheck condition for the exact 13 location targets. It adds no source-value, numeric/mechanics, context, or default/first-region grade.

rootAcceptedTargetChecks.manualBindingCanonicalHashes: 13/13 match current R5 records; exactly one manual binding per target

checksPerformed: Verified all proposal file pins and all manifest input hashes against the live read-only R5 source inputs.
Verified the failure TAP hash and its reported assertion/location.
Ran node --check on the proposed replacement test; PASS.
Resolved the historical Git source blob and verified its SHA/size, fixture projection, 120-record status set, identity multiset, and intentional repeated-key groups.
Compared the current source epoch, root manifest/receipt hashes, summary derivation, 13 unique accepted identities, and all four canonical hash classes per accepted target.
Recomputed all 175 old175 physical record hashes and sizes against the current read-only repository; all match.
limitations: The proposal's recorded isolated temporary overlay test reports 4/4 passing; this peer review did not rerun that test.
Integrated R7 CI and shard rerun remain pending; the proposal is not installed or deployed.
The root image/PDF pixels were not re-reviewed here; the pinned root receipt is treated as the current independent location-review evidence, with its declared limited scope.

The compact fixture contains 120 binding records and 109 distinct four-part identity keys. The test compares identity arrays as a multiset, preserving 11 legitimate repeated region-alternative records.
